visualCharacteristics.purpose: Pull quote or inline quotation with an optional attribution
visualCharacteristics.layout: Left-ruled quotation; sits inside narrow article prose or alone in the wide column of a 'split' section beside a default-content list
visualCharacteristics.description: 4px orange left rule, 24px indent, italic quotation text (larger when standalone in a split section), optional small uppercase attribution prefixed with an em dash.

contentPattern.structure: row 1: quotation (one or more paragraphs); row 2 (optional): attribution
contentPattern.notes: Row 2 is optional; without it the block renders the quotation only. A leading '—' typed in the attribution is stripped and re-added by CSS, so authors may include it or not. Both rows may also be authored as two cells of one row.

usage.description: Inline quotes in blog article prose and the standalone pull quote beside the gear list.

reuseGuidance: Use for any quotation outside an interactive component, with or without attribution, inline in prose or standalone. Do not nest it in Columns; use a 'split' section with default content beside it instead.
